# FloridAuto.com

> Florida auto insurance from an independent agency — same-day coverage,
> SR-22 filings, and drivers other agents turn away. Part of Tomlinson & Co,
> licensed since 1966. Quotes: 800-616-1418.

FloridAuto.com is the personal auto division of Tomlinson & Co, an independent
insurance agency writing coverage across Florida. As an independent agency we
are not tied to a single carrier; we compare quotes across multiple insurers,
including markets that specialise in non-standard risk.

## What we write

- **Liability** — bodily injury and property damage, at the limits Florida
  requires and above
- **Personal Injury Protection (PIP)** — Florida's no-fault coverage
- **Uninsured / underinsured motorist** — protection when the at-fault driver
  has no insurance or too little
- **Comprehensive and collision** — physical damage to your own vehicle
- **SR-22 filings** — proof of financial responsibility after a licence
  suspension or serious violation

## What makes us useful to Florida drivers

- **Same-day coverage.** Policies that can be bound the day you call.
- **Non-standard and high-risk.** DUI, at-fault accidents, tickets, lapses in
  coverage, and drivers who have been declined elsewhere.
- **SR-22.** Filed directly with the state so the licence reinstatement is not
  held up.
- **Bundling.** Auto combined with home or flood for multi-policy discounts —
  see hoinsurance.com for the property side.

## Service area

Florida, statewide.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Premium and eligibility depend on the driver and vehicle: record, location,
  vehicle, coverage limits, and prior insurance history. Figures in articles are
  general market context, not quotes.
- Nothing on this site binds coverage. A licensed agent must review the risk and
  issue a policy.
- Florida's no-fault and tort rules changed materially between 2025 and 2026.
  Prefer the most recent article by date when articles appear to conflict.
